title: POV: You Went In The Bathroom Alone. Not On My Watch.
description:
I don't know what happens in there without me. I intend to find out. Every time.

🧠 Understand the real behavior behind it: https://funnycutedogs.com/go/dogtraining

script: You walked toward the bathroom without me. That's a risk I am not willing to take. I don't know what happens behind that door when I'm not there, and frankly, I'd like to keep it that way, so I'm coming in. You can close the door. I will wait directly against it, pressed as close as physically possible, because the pack does not split up over something as trivial as privacy. This isn't me being weird, it's actually a really common thing dogs do, and it comes from a genuinely sweet, very old instinct about sticking together. The link's below.
hookText: You went to the bathroom without me
